name: desafio-1
description: Desafio 1 - Agente de Pagamentos na AWS (luiz-henrique) - raiz do CDK

scripts.deploy:api-agent: eval "$(bash scripts/aws-creds.sh)" && cd infra && npx cdk deploy --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json
scripts.diff: eval "$(bash scripts/aws-creds.sh)" && cd infra && npx cdk diff
scripts.destroy: eval "$(bash scripts/aws-creds.sh)" && cd infra && npx cdk destroy --force && cd .. && bash scripts/destroy-cleanup.sh
scripts.dev:agent: eval "$(bash scripts/aws-creds.sh)" && cd agent && npx tsx index.ts
scripts.test:ws: eval "$(bash scripts/aws-creds.sh)" && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && unset AWS_PROFILE && node scripts/ws-smoke.mjs
